text:
jin: Quick sync: canary-503 shows p99 spike on long streams after kv-evict defaults changed. suspect host parse + stream fragmentation. logging here so folks can follow.

omar: Flamegraph shows parse_split and grpc::Writev dominate CPU. kernel_selector shows many short-sequence fallbacks. snippet: 
```
parse::split_frame 40%
grpc::Writev       24%
kvcache::evict     10%
proto::unpack       7%
kernel_selector::fb 6%
```

nina: Logs show lots of small writev calls interleaved with kv_miss events. example: 
```
[2026-05-05T11:02:01.001Z] req=q1 writev bytes=256 dur=200us
[2026-05-05T11:02:01.001Z] req=q1 writev bytes=64 dur=170us
[2026-05-05T11:02:01.002Z] req=q1 kv_miss key="sess:77"
[2026-05-05T11:02:01.003Z] req=q1 parse.split=1.4ms proto_unwrap=0.8ms
```

paul: Hypothesis: eviction churn forces extra proto reserializations which fragment streaming writes and increase host CPU per token. Also batching heuristic default (min_batch_ms=2) may be too low for heavy tails.

jin: Proposed experiments: 1) proto-coalesce toggle on ingress 2) increase min_batch_ms to {2,6,12} 3) kv backoff TTL bump for hot keys 4) prefer slim kernel for <512 tokens. We'll run a factorial microbench and capture p50/p99/p999 plus kv-hit-rate and throughput per size bucket.

omar: ran a quick dry-run: min_batch_ms=6 + coalesce reduced p99 from 460ms->310ms and improved kv-hit by ~5%. tiny requests (<32 tokens) latency up slightly; need A/B by bucket.

nina: I'll prototype kv-backoff (counter-based TTL) as a feature-flag. paul: can you build a canary image that sets kernel_pref_threshold=512?

paul: on it. also adding tracepoints to correlate writev counts with kv evict events.

infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: service=host-ingress canary_id=canary-503 window=2026-05-05T10:50->12:00. Observability: alert host.ingress.latency.p99 triggered 2026-05-05T11:02. Runbook updated with proto-coalesce and batch-ms experiment steps.

jin: We'll avoid full rollback until matrix finishes. Action owners: @omar run microbench + pprofs, @nina feature-flag kv-backoff, @paul toggle kernel pref in canary image. Capture flamegraphs and attach to ticket.

omar: posting full numbers in ~30m. initial numbers look promising. :thumbsup:
